App.title: Coffee Timer
App.description: Simple, relaxing timer for your daily tasks

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.audioNeedsInteractionDescription: Browser autoplay rules require a click on the test button or timer start before sound can play.
Settings.audioReadyDescription: If you cannot hear the test, check this site's browser sound setting and your OS volume.

Notifications.permissionGrantedDescription: You will receive notifications when the timer completes
Notifications.permissionDeniedDescription: Please enable notifications in your browser settings
Notifications.permissionDeniedHelp: This site cannot ask again. Open the browser's site settings from the address bar and set Notifications to Allow.
Notifications.permissionDefaultDescription: Turn this on to open the browser permission prompt.
Notifications.testNotificationDescription: Send a test notification using the current sound and volume settings
